name: Reducto
one_liner: Agentic document platform to parse, extract, split, classify and edit documents via REST API, SDKs, CLI and MCP.
auth_notes: API key from Studio (studio.reducto.ai) API Keys page; SDKs read REDUCTO_API_KEY; sent as Bearer. The openapi.json URL currently returns 'temporarily unavailable'.
access_notes: Standard pay-as-you-go plan with $150 free usage then list rates; Growth/Enterprise via sales add rate limits, BAA, data residency. Startup program credits.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key with free starter usage, documented REST endpoints (parse, extract, split, classify, edit, upload, async variants, job), webhooks on async calls, official MCP. Concurrency 429s documented without numbers.

disputes.why: Pricing page: Standard pay-as-you-go includes $150 of free usage, then list rates apply.
Agent guide lists about 13 endpoints (parse, extract, split, classify, edit, upload, 5 async, job).
Agent guide says Python, Node.js, and Go SDKs read REDUCTO_API_KEY.

identity.quote: Reducto turns PDFs, spreadsheets, images, and office files into structured data.

auth.quote: The Python, Node.js, and Go SDKs read `REDUCTO_API_KEY` from the environment.

access.quote: Standard includes $150 of free usage, then list rates apply.

api_surface.quote: | 429 | Rate limited | Too many concurrent requests. Retry with backoff. |

mcp.quote: Connect AI agents to Reducto via the Model Context Protocol.
